WaterDemandNorms2.name: Residential Area / Independent House / Builder Floor / Residential Flat / Apartment Complex / Group Housing Society / Residential Colony / Government Residential Quarter
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Updated DJB residential norm. Occupancy is 5 persons per dwelling unit (DU). Total water demand is 225 LPCD, comprising 180 LPCD potable water and 45 LPCD non-potable water.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Colleges / Schools / Destitute Homes / Charitable Homes / Universities
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Occupancy is the higher of built-up area divided by 4 sqm or total strength including staff and students. For schools running double shifts, the applicable double-shift strength must be included in the calculation. All area-based calculations use built-up area, including FAR and non-FAR area.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Mercantile / Assembly / Petrol Pumps / Laundry and Other Listed Uses
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Includes the mercantile, assembly, petrol pump, laundry and related uses listed in the revised norms. Occupancy is 1 person per 4.5 sqm of built-up area. Built-up area includes FAR and non-FAR area.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Offices / Banks / Police / Laboratories / Clinics Without IPD or Beds / Industrial Utilities and Other Listed Uses
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Includes the offices, banks, police stations, laboratories, private clinics without IPD/bed facilities, industrial utilities and related uses listed in the revised norms. Occupancy is 1 person per 10 sqm of built-up area. Built-up area includes FAR and non-FAR area.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Storage / Multilevel Parking / Cremation or Burial Ground / Golf Course / Sports Complex / Place of Worship
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Includes storage facilities, warehouses, cold storage, freight depots, electric substations/distribution grids, approved multilevel parking, cremation/burial grounds, golf courses/sports complexes and places of worship. The source row states 1 person per 30 sqm of FAR area, while the general note says all area calculations are to use built-up area (FAR + non-FAR); accordingly the formula uses built-up area.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Hotels / Hostels / Dormitories / Lodging / Custodial / Penal and Mental Institutions / Orphanages / Dharamshalas / Clubs / Commercial Complexes / Convention Centres
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Use the specified bed count where available; otherwise estimate at 1 bed per 7.5 sqm of built-up area, whichever is higher. Water demand is 180 LPCD per bed, comprising 135 LPCD potable and 45 LPCD non-potable. Built-up area includes FAR and non-FAR area.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Hotels (3-Star and Above) / Resorts / Banquet or Marriage Halls / Malls
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Use the specified bed count wherever it is provided. If the bed count is not specified, occupancy is the higher of 2 beds per room or 1 bed per 12.5 sqm of built-up area. Water demand is 320 LPCD per bed, comprising 275 LPCD potable and 45 LPCD non-potable. Built-up area includes FAR and non-FAR area.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Restaurants / Canteens / Pantries / Dhabas or Eating Establishments / Food Courts
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Occupancy is 1 person per 1.5 sqm of built-up area. Total water demand is 70 LPCD, comprising 15 LPCD potable and 55 LPCD non-potable. Built-up area includes FAR and non-FAR area.

WaterDemandNorms2.name: Nursing Homes / Hospitals / Sanatoria
WaterDemandNorms2.description: Occupancy is the number of beds. For up to 100 beds, demand is 340 LPCD per bed and potable requirement is 250 LPCD per bed. Above 100 beds, demand is 450 LPCD per bed and potable requirement is 360 LPCD per bed. Non-potable requirement is 90 LPCD per bed in both bands.
